title: Review the existing five-domain passive PHP inventory
instructions: Review the attached public repository, especially AGENTS.md, advisory.json, research/passive-batch-001.json, and schemas/observation.schema.json. The leader must assign distinct primary-advisory research to claude-researcher and independent source/evidence review to opencode-reviewer, using the board and waiting for both before final completion. The batch is exactly the existing five candidate hostnames. You may fetch only the named profiling-service pages and primary advisory URLs. Do not contact candidate hostnames, enumerate new domains, run port scans, test CVEs, send exploit payloads, alter scope.json, or contact owners. Keep both CVE statuses unknown unless real owner-runtime/package evidence supports a different result; none is currently supplied. Do not search for credentials, request new credentials, or attempt to push: repository access is public read-only, and the operator will inspect and push the final report. Produce a structured JSON review with batch_id, source_urls, findings, corrections, limitations, per-CVE assessment, candidate_host_requests_sent:0, and reviewer handles. Write it locally to research/passive-batch-001-review.json and also put its complete JSON into a team note titled passive-batch-001-review using write_note. Keep the JSON under 16000 characters. Settle all board tasks, have both colleagues report, then the leader declares completion. Report any source-access failures honestly. End after this single review; do not create another mission or scheduled process.
